title: Priceless Coins
text: Priceless Coins are rare given currency the players can use to buy 30-day items, Mounts and Gliders, which are possible to be upgraded into permanent one with Activity Tokens. Currently 6.2.2026 there are 3 obtainable coins in the game. 5 total for players who claimed the 1st and 2nd anniversary coins. 1st coin Outside of any Mirage Portal is a Auctioneer Daru NPC. This NPC has a quest that gives the first coin. 2nd coin Second coins is given by the achievement called "Harvest Festival Participant". Meaning player has to take part in the custom event 5 times to get the achievement. This achievement can be found under General > Misc. 3rd coin Third Priceless coin was a reward from the web page for 1st year anniversary of Archeage Classic. LIMITED TIME ONLY, NO LONGER AVAILABLE 4th coin Fourth Priceless coin was a reward for the 2nd year anniversary of Archeage Classic. Talk to the Auctioneer Daru NPC in the main cities. He will give a quest to go to Mirage Island to talk to Daru Priest who will give the coin as reward. html:
Priceless Coins are rare given currency the players can use to buy 30-day items, Mounts and Gliders, which are possible to be upgraded into permanent one with Activity Tokens.

Currently 6.2.2026 there are 3 obtainable coins in the game.

5 total for players who claimed the 1st and 2nd anniversary coins.

1st coin

Outside of any Mirage Portal is a Auctioneer Daru NPC. This NPC has a quest that gives the first coin.


2nd coin

Second coins is given by the achievement called "Harvest Festival Participant". Meaning player has to take part in the custom event 5 times to get the achievement. This achievement can be found under General > Misc.


3rd coin

Third Priceless coin was a reward from the web page for 1st year anniversary of Archeage Classic.

LIMITED TIME ONLY, NO LONGER AVAILABLE

4th coin

Fourth Priceless coin was a reward for the 2nd year anniversary of Archeage Classic.

Talk to the Auctioneer Daru NPC in the main cities. He will give a quest to go to Mirage Island to talk to Daru Priest who will give the coin as reward.

LIMITED TIME ONLY, NO LONGER AVAILABLE

5th coin

Fifth coin can be obtained from the new Adventurer's Guide tab. After completing Arcane grade missions the reward chest gives one Priceless Coin.
